title: Frobenius preserves an open subscheme defined over the finite field
statement:
Fix the finite-field datum $(p,a,q,k_0,k)$ of [def-weil-finite-field-fiber].
Let $j_0:X_0\hookrightarrow Y_0$ be an open immersion [def-weil-open-immersion]
of $k_0$-schemes [def-weil-scheme-over-base], where $k_0=\mathbf F_q$,
and let $j:X\hookrightarrow Y$ be its base change to $k$ [def-pc-base-change].
Here $X=X_0\times_{k_0}\operatorname{Spec}k$ and
$Y=Y_0\times_{k_0}\operatorname{Spec}k$; write $a_X,a_Y$ for the projections
 to $s=\operatorname{Spec}k$ [def-pc-fibre-product].
For $Z_0=X_0,Y_0$, let $F_{Z_0}$ be its absolute $p$-power Frobenius
[def-weil-absolute-frobenius-scheme], and put
$\Phi_{Z_0}=F_{Z_0}^{a}$ and
$\Phi_Z=\Phi_{Z_0}\times_{k_0}\operatorname{id}_k$.
Thus $\Phi_{Z_0}$ is the $q$-power scheme Frobenius (on sections, $r\mapsto r^q$).
Let $\gamma=(z\mapsto z^q)^{-1}\in\operatorname{Gal}(k/k_0)$
[def-weil-frobenius-substitution], put $g_s=\operatorname{Spec}(\gamma)$
[def-weil-affine-spectrum], and let
$g_Z=\operatorname{id}_{Z_0}\times_{k_0}g_s$.
These constructions do not require a finite-type hypothesis.
For each integer $m\geq0$, each square

$$
\begin{array}{ccc}
X&\xrightarrow{h}&X\\
{\scriptstyle j}\downarrow&&\downarrow{\scriptstyle j}\\
Y&\xrightarrow{\bar h}&Y
\end{array}
$$

is Cartesian (in the category of schemes), where
$(h,\bar h)=(\Phi_X^m,\Phi_Y^m)$ or $(g_X^m,g_Y^m)$.
Moreover,

$$
a_Xg_X^m=g_s^ma_X,\qquad a_Yg_Y^m=g_s^ma_Y.
$$

In particular these Galois maps are not asserted to be $k$-morphisms.

proof.text: Use the existing unrestricted characteristic and base-linearity theorems of [def-weil-relative-frobenius-geometric-fiber] to regard the actual absolute iterates [def-weil-absolute-frobenius-scheme] as endomorphisms of the models over the finite base. Naturality is proved directly: both underlying maps are the given model morphism, and on each ring of sections the equality is the ring-homomorphism identity $f(s^{p^a})=f(s)^{p^a}$. Applying the base-change functor [def-pc-base-change] proves that the two base-changed Frobenii commute with the base-changed open immersion.

Apply [lem-weil-pbc-open-fibre-product] with the model inclusion, the identity on the scalar scheme and the identity on the base. Its two Mathlib clauses Scheme.pullback_map_isOpenImmersion and Scheme.Pullback.range_map prove that $j$ is open and its image is precisely the inverse image of the model open under the first projection. The first projection of the base-changed Frobenius is the first projection followed by model Frobenius, by [def-pc-fibre-product]. Model Frobenius is identity on points, so the inverse image of the image of $j$ under the base-changed Frobenius is again the image of $j$. IsOpenImmersion.isPullback, the generic open-immersion pullback criterion from [def-weil-open-immersion], now proves the square for one iterate directly on the scalar extension. This avoids constructing and then base-changing the model pullback square.

The existing coefficient-action inverse and projection identities of [def-weil-frobenius-detailed] apply to arbitrary models, without finite-type hypotheses. Compare first projections to see that both composites with $j$ fix the model and compare second projections to see that both act by the same scalar automorphism. Pullback hom-extensionality from [def-pc-fibre-product] gives commutativity. The explicit inverse identities make both coefficient actions isomorphisms, so IsPullback.of_horiz_isIso proves their Cartesian square.

For either Cartesian square, prove the assertion for every nonnegative power by induction. At zero use the Cartesian square of identity maps. At a successor paste the one-step square horizontally with the previously proved square; End multiplication is reverse categorical composition, so the resulting composites are exactly the successor powers. This uses only pullback pasting, hence [def-pc-fibre-product].

For each model the second projection identity of [def-weil-frobenius-detailed] states $g_Z a_Z=a_Z g_s$ in diagrammatic composition. Induct on the power: identity compositions prove zero, and associativity with the one-step identity proves the successor. Apply this same proved helper to both models, giving exactly the two required semilinearity identities.

Naturality: varieties.tex definition-absolute-frobenius and lemma-frobenius-endomorphism-identity (03SM, 0CC7). Galois square and semilinearity: existing FrobeniusDetailed inverse and projection identities, followed by elementary isomorphism pullback and induction. C5, 2026-10-18.

reviewed.note: mechanical checks by tools/merge_delivery.py; mathematics reviewed in full by NT-cc-Q44-f412cfe42 (reviewer sub-agent of L); spot-checked: I read the full item, both blueprint snapshots (master order 2368 and main-20261015 order 2712, with identical statement and proof), Stacks 03SM (varieties.tex:7014-7029), 01JR (schemes.tex:3198-3218) and 01JP, and every cited statement. The B3 repair is exactly what coord/returns/Q44.md asked for: def-weil-relative-frobenius-geometric-fiber and def-weil-frobenius-detailed are removed from stmt_deps. Both are finite-type-only and the self-contained statement does not use them, so the 8 stmt_deps now match the 8 bracketed references. The statement uses the same maps as def-trf-scheme-frobenius (Phi_Z = q-power Frobenius x id_k, gamma = phi_q^{-1}, g_Z = id x Spec gamma). It keeps both Cartesian squares for all m>=0 and both semilinear equalities in the source's orientation. Dropping the finite-type hypothesis makes it stronger, and that is true. Step 1: characteristic p comes from the unital map k_0 -> O(U); the Frobenius restricts to the open; it lies over S_0 because c^q = c. Step 2: lem-weil-pbc-open-preimage-fibre-product with f = Phi^m_{Y0}, V = X_0, arrows in the right orientation. Step 3: I rechecked the universal property; p_Y and a_Y give j_0u_0 = Phi^m v_0 and a_Xu = a_Yv, and the lift (w_0,t) exists and is unique. Step 4: g_X^m is invertible, so the lift g_X^{-m}u works and is unique. Step 5: projection identity. No step uses finiteness. Edge cases checked: m=0, empty X_0 or Y_0, j_0 = id, Spec k_0, k_0[e]/(e^2), D(t) in A^1, and a non-finite-type model. No new nodes. lem-weil-frobenius-square-cartesian (another unit, m=1 Galois square only) overlaps only the Galois half and is not needed. No tool_uses, no fixes. The stage-2 lean.note mentioning the two removed defs is now stale, but lean is not split-owned.
